label: magic chalk
description: A stub of chalk, warm in your hand, that never seems to wear down. Wherever you draw with it, a line of pale light stays behind in the stone.

label: charm sigil
description: A closed ring of chalk traced around a vacant space on the floor. When an enemy is encircled on every side by such rings, the circle closes and draws it into step with you. The ring flares once and is spent.
look_description: A closed ring of pale chalk glows faintly on the floor, waiting to be completed around something.

label: drain sigil
description: A spiral chalk mark that drinks the energy from whatever stands on it. Each pass of the spiral drinks a little more, then the mark fades. It holds five drainings before it is spent.
look_description: A tight spiral of chalk that seems to drink the light from the floor, leaving the stone cold and grey.

label: worn scroll
description: A dry scroll of old bark, faintly warm, showing an intricate spiral in charcoal. Reading it presses the words for drawing a draining sigil into your head.
look_description: A spiral of charcoal spirals on the bark — a diagram for sapping the strength of whatever stands within.

label: ember scroll
description: A sheet of fire-cured bark marked with a round amber sigil. Reading it reveals the lines that call a creature into being.
look_description: Amber strokes circle a tiny ember at the scroll's center — a diagram for a spawning sigil.

label: chisel-axe
description: A wedge of chipped stone half-wrapped in greasy hide, a goblin's skinning tool. It bites into meat and stone alike.

label: moss poultice
description: A wad of crushed herbs and wet moss tied in a scrap of hide. Goblin medicine — it mends wounds the way they mend hides.

label: shaman's ring
description: A ring of dark carved bone and clay, still warm from shaping. It holds the shaman's cunning, an eye for shape and purpose. On your finger it sharpens your mind, and the surviving golems bow to your will.

label: spawn sigil
description: A round sigil drawn in living amber, warm in the hand. It holds the raw names of creatures that can be summoned to this board. What answers the call, and how strong it stands, depends on the strength of the patron who traces it.
look_description: A disc of warm amber chalk, its spiral glowing faintly. It hums against the floor like a buried coal.

label: elmwood leaf-blade
description: A leaf-shaped blade turned from one piece of elmwood, edge oiled with black sap. The pawns of the pale army carry these in their boots; a quiet knife for a patient soldier.

label: bark bracer
description: A bracer of living bark bound to the forearm with root-thread. It answers to the arm as if it had grown there.

label: antler saber
description: A saber set on an antler hilt with three points whorled like a hilltop. It favors a long, singing reach.

label: elmwood greaves
description: Greaves cut from iron-elm, old enough that the grain has gone to stone. They clatter like hooves on the stair.

label: iron-elm greatbow
description: A three-span greatbow cut from iron-elm and strung with dead root-cord. It takes two hands and a held breath, and puts a yard of wood through a company.

label: bark mantle
description: A mantle of bark peeled from an old queen's tree, hardened into plate across the shoulders. The wood remembers what it was cut to shield.

label: moonlit reed ring
description: A ring braided from reeds that grew under the pale moon, cool to the touch. It sharpens the mind the way moonlight sharpens a silhouette.

label: moss-light cowl
description: A cowl woven from moss that holds its own faint light. The light has nothing to say to anyone, but it reads the dark for you.

label: mirrorshard glaive
description: A glaive of trappers' glass, dark but for a seam of moonlight caught forever inside. Queen's-court steel, or the cold twin of it.

label: moonlit mail
description: Mail tempered under a milk-pale moon, each link a small cold eye. The moon's court wears it beneath their cloaks.

label: driftwood crown
description: A crown of pale driftwood grown in the root-dark, cool and smooth, without a single knot. The queen's crown is the eldest thing on the board.

label: throneroot cloak
description: A cloak of the king's throne-root, soft as river silt and fringed with fine sewn roots. It holds the weight of every word spoken at court.
